user.title: Trybatec account
user.description: Enter the credentials for the Trybatec portal and the UUID from your portal's /indexes/ page URL. This is an unofficial integration.

data.deal_id: Deal ID (UUID from the Indexes page URL)

error.cannot_connect: Unable to retrieve data from Trybatec.
error.invalid_deal_id: The deal ID must be a UUID.

abort.already_configured: This Trybatec account and deal are already configured.

init.title: Trybatec options
init.description: Tariff JSON example: {"2025": {"EF": {"rate": 4.25, "status": "provisional"}}. Supported fluids: EF, ECS, CET. Costs are estimates, not a billing statement.

error.invalid_tariffs: Invalid tariff JSON. See the example.

preview_history.name: Preview historical readings
preview_history.description: Reads available Trybatec historical meter indexes and reports gaps; never changes Home Assistant statistics.

entry_id.name: Account entry ID
entry_id.description: Optional if exactly one Trybatec account is installed.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; start of the historical period (default 2021-01-01).

import_history.name: Import historical statistics
import_history.description: EXPERIMENTAL: queues distinct, external long-term statistics. Make a backup, run the preview first, and explicitly confirm.

entry_id.name: Account entry ID
entry_id.description: Optional if exactly one account is installed.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; do not change between re-imports of the same series.

include_heating.name: Include heating
include_heating.description: Off by default because heating units may not be kWh.

confirm_heating_kwh.name: Confirm heating is kWh
confirm_heating_kwh.description: Required when including heating. Do not check for allocation units.

allow_gaps.name: Allow gaps
allow_gaps.description: Accept observed intervals longer than 3 days without interpolation.

confirm.name: Confirm import
confirm.description: Required: confirms backup, preview and consent to queue recorder database changes.
